purpose: Measure specific properties and support expert review; no global aesthetic score. No Zidao appearance reference.
normative_reference: Selected WCAG 2.2 AA criteria; NOT a complete WCAG compliance checklist

metrics.exceptions: Inactive, incidental and logo text and other criterion-specific conditions must be assessed; conventional font size rule is only a classifier.

metrics.scope: Visual information necessary to identify UI controls, states and meaningful graphics; assess exceptions.

metrics.exceptions: Spacing, equivalent target, inline, user-agent control and essential presentation; bounding rect alone cannot decide compliance.
Content requiring two-dimensional layout; no loss of information or functionality.

metrics.scope: No loss of content/functionality with criterion exceptions.
Primary touch controls; adopt in design contract before using as a gate. Not WCAG AA universal minimum.
Main reading text; secondary/dense content assessed separately. Not a universal WCAG minimum.
Meaningful content and required actions; intentional overlays and scrolling are not automatically defects.

metrics.denominator: Selected applicable required screen/state/viewport/theme/scenario cases enumerated before testing. Unknown cases do not count as covered.

metrics.scope: Properties for which this project has adopted tokens; documented exceptions remain visible.
Calibrate per component, platform and rendering noise. A small diff is not proof of good design.
Use actual participants/protocol/baseline and report sample size. Agent opinion is not user-study evidence.

performance_reference.aggregation: 75th percentile of field visits, segmented mobile/desktop; lab results are separate

viewport_policy: Select applicable cases and include relevant breakpoint boundaries. Test live resize/state persistence; fixed screenshots alone are insufficient.
unknown_policy: Unknown required observation blocks readiness; optional observations remain explicit limitations.
